title: Close Direction with an FVG Below
summary: Of the sessions that started with an unfilled session-level fair value gap entirely below the open: zones form on prior sessions only, so there is no lookahead: how often the session closed above its open. The denominator is sessions carrying such a zone at the open; the numerator is the green ones. Read it against the baseline green rate: the zone matters only if this interval and the baseline's separate, and 'no difference' is a legitimate, publishable answer.
deltas: a testable FVG claim with a stated denominator, instead of chart anecdotes
